Chapter 750: Chapter 33: Pushing Heaven'S Gate (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 750: Chapter 33: Pushing Heaven’s Gate (Seeking Subscriptions)

Cosmic Starry Skies.

The facial expressions of the Supreme Beings changed suddenly.

In the Two-dimensional World, at the summit of Heavenly Mountain, they became aware of the unfolding events in real time.

The Four Divine Kings, a thin old man, and other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Strengths had barely come into contact with that human “Xueyu” when they were gravely injured and near death.

The two parties were simply not on the same level, with the former powerless to even struggle or resist in the presence of the latter.

Even though they possessed defense treasures to protect themselves, in the Two-dimensional World, these defense treasures could only exert minimal power and were utterly incapable of blocking Lin Yuan’s attack.

...

“Xia Qin, have your human Evolvers stop,” a Supreme Being from the Star Alliance urged, unable to sit still any longer.

The Four Divine Kings were the most likely candidates in the Star Alliance to reach Ultimate Eleventh-Rank Life. If they died simply like this in the Two-dimensional World from fundamental losses to their Spirit Will, no one knew how long it would take to recover.

It might even be possible that they could not recover at all, which would lessen their hopes of reaching the Ultimate greatly.

“Xia Qin, let’s talk this over,” a Supreme Being from the Yu Clan immediately communicated, as two of the five Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives came from the Yu Clan.

Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, even for the Peak Clans, were foundational, ranked on the reserve list for Ultimate, and it was unknown how long one might take to emerge.

Although dying in the Two-dimensional World meant only the avatar perished, the fundamental loss would diminish the eventual probability of achieving the Ultimate, which wasn’t much different from a complete demise.

The possibility of successfully achieving the Ultimate was already minuscule, and further reduction made attempting to reach the Ultimate no different from courting death.

“Oh?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at the other Ultimates who were continuously sending messages to him.

“We had already agreed not to interfere with our clan members’ actions in the Two-dimensional World. It’s tough for me to do anything when you approach me like this…” Xia Qin Supreme Being said indifferently.

“I’m willing to offer…” a Supreme Being from the Star Alliance immediately spoke.

In the end, the Star Alliance paid a price that greatly satisfied Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Alright, let me ask first…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at the Yu Clan’s Supreme Being.

“My clan is also willing to offer…”

The Yu Clan’s Supreme Being’s heart was bleeding internally as he spoke stiffly.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan stood in the personal world of the Supreme Being, looking up at Xia Qin Supreme Being seated on the throne.

“The Supreme Being asked me to spare the Four Divine Kings for now…” Lin Yuan thought to himself, guessing that Xia Qin Supreme Being might be negotiating with other Ultimate beings.

A moment later.

A smile appeared on the face of Xia Qin Supreme Being seated on the throne.

“Hahahaha.”

“This really made those old guys bleed heavily,” Xia Qin Supreme Being began, sounding quite pleased.

“Bleed?”

Lin Yuan looked towards Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Yes.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded, “How could they not pay a price to save their clan members?”

As he said this, Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan with satisfaction: “About the Four Divine Kings and others, there’s no need to kill them now. I’ll give you eighty percent of the compensation.”

“Okay.”

Lin Yuan immediately agreed.

Xia Qin Supreme Being had only asked him to spare the Four Divine Kings and the thin old man’s lives and did not mention sparing their treasures.

Lin Yuan could take all the treasures possessed by the Four Divine Kings, the thin old man, and the other strong beings, then spare their lives.

“By the way, for that Ultimate weapon embedded in the Four Divine King’s body, don’t forcibly extract it,” Xia Qin Supreme Being added. “The one from the Star Alliance has agreed to trade for two Ultimate weapons.”

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

To Lin Yuan, the Four Divine Kings’ Ultimate weapon was no different from ordinary treasures.

Trading one for two was absolutely a great deal.

…

Two-dimensional World.

Atop the mountain.

Lin Yuan’s vigor surged, enveloping the entire mountain summit. The Four Divine Kings, the thin old man, and the other six strong beings had completely lost their ability to resist.

The numerous powerhouses of the Myriad Clans below the summit were in utter turmoil.

The strength displayed by Lin Yuan was terrifyingly formidable, far surpassing the gap between the Four Divine Kings and these Tier 10 and Tier 11 powerhouses.

“Why has this person from Human Civilization, ‘Lord Xueyu,’ stopped attacking?”

“Nonsense, it must be because the Ultimate beings behind the Four Divine Kings have reached out to the Supreme Being of the Human Civilization for negotiations,” they speculated.

“Exactly, other special life forms’ avatars, even if they die in this Two-dimensional World, the Star Alliance wouldn’t bother. But it’s different for the Four Divine Kings; he is their most hopeful candidate to become an Ultimate.”

The Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses were astonished internally, looking at Lin Yuan standing in the center of the summit, their souls trembling.

If they had not been sure that those who descended into this Two-dimensional World were Tier 11 and below, they would even suspect that Lin Yuan was a Supreme Being.

If he isn’t a Supreme Being, how could he possibly suppress everything in this two-dimensional World, growing at a speed far surpassing the Four Divine Kings?

A gap of one or two realms could still be comprehended, three or four realms were reluctantly acceptable.

But the gap between Lin Yuan and the Four Divine Kings was probably ten or twenty realms? Many would believe it if he were called a Supreme Being.

In the middle of the summit.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, looked toward the Four Divine Kings, the thin old man, and the other six strong beings, and said, “Hand over all your treasures, and you are free to leave.”

“Hand over the treasures?”

The Four Divine Kings and the others exchanged glances, slightly relieved inside.

Although parting with their treasures was heart-wrenching, at least this avatar was preserved.

“The strongest weapon merged within my body…” the Four Divine Kings whispered softly.

“You may keep it,” Lin Yuan glanced briefly at the other.

This had also been specially instructed by Xia Qin Supreme Being.

The strongest weapon within the Four Divine Kings was of little significance to Lin Yuan.

Very soon.

Six powerhouses handed over all the extraordinary items they carried.

Among them, the Four Divine Kings had four extraordinary items, the thin old man had five, and the other four collectively had eighteen.

From this battle alone, Lin Yuan had acquired twenty-seven extraordinary items, which, added to those he had collected over the past three hundred years, brought the total to over thirty.

This total didn’t even include what other Supreme Beings had paid Lin Yuan to spare the lives of the Four Divine Kings and the other six powerhouses.

All in all, as long as Lin Yuan could make it out of the Two-dimensional World smoothly, his gain would reach an unprecedented level, amassing a wealth that an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse couldn’t accumulate in ten lifetimes.

After storing all the extraordinary items in the mirror’s inner space, Lin Yuan voluntarily suppressed his own aura, gradually dissipating the blood and force field spreading over the entire summit.

“You may leave now.”

Lin Yuan turned around, standing afresh before the heavenly gate.

From attacking the Four Divine Kings and the other powerhouses to completely suppressing them, and receiving instructions from Xia Qin Supreme Being, not much time had actually passed.

Even now, the heavenly gate in front of him had not fully materialized.

“Are you a Supreme Being?” The Four Divine Kings suddenly asked before leaving.

If Lin Yuan were a Supreme Being, he could somewhat accept the defeat more gracefully, as losing to a Supreme Being wasn’t shameful.

“A Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan shook his head, “I am not.”

He was not only not a Supreme Being, but he wasn’t even an Eleventh-Rank Life.

Not a Supreme Being… the Four Divine Kings fell silent. Given Lin Yuan’s capabilities, he seemed unlikely to lie, probably some hidden Eleventh-Rank Evolver from Human Civilization.

“I will remember this battle forever,” the Four Divine Kings said deeply, looking at Lin Yuan intensely before departing.

Since their inception, they had never experienced such a crushing defeat, one so decisively executed.

Whoosh.

The Four Divine Kings rapidly moved away.

The injuries Lin Yuan caused had largely healed. For a power from Ancestor Witch’s Thirty Realms, as long as the brain and heart weren’t shattered, injuries to other organs would swiftly recover.

“We shall leave as well.”

The thin old man and the other four powerhouses also rapidly departed.

For a time, the summit of Heavenly Mountain was left with only Lin Yuan.

To be precise, at the edge of the summit, there were also Xuanyuan Dua and several other human evolvers.

Besides them, all powerhouses from the Myriad Clans, including even those Eleventh Rank Powerhouses, had withdrawn from the summit’s vicinity, only daring to observe from midway up the mountain.

“Too strong.”

Hou Zhu of the Prison Tribe stood in a corner near the summit, staring at Lin Yuan standing before the heavenly gate, flooded with a sense of immense despair.

Initially, he thought that with the mysteries within his crimson long knife and after understanding many killing moves, he might try to compete for an opportunity to enter when the heavenly gate opened.

But reality had harshly slapped him.

Without mentioning the others, just the Four Divine Kings and the thin old man could crush him, let alone Lin Yuan, who emerged out of nowhere and crushed the likes of the Four Divine Kings.

…

“Lord Xueyu is so powerful?”

On the side of Human Civilization, Xuanyuan Dua and the other evolvers were bewildered; the surprise came too suddenly for them.

How had they done nothing, yet Lin Yuan was already standing before the heavenly gate, just waiting for it to fully materialize so he could enter.

“Why isn’t the Galaxy Master here yet?”

Among the group of Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, Nalan refocused and began to look around the middle slopes, searching for the Galaxy Master.

…

“Is this the heavenly gate?”

Compared to the shock of the many powerhouses from the Myriad Clans, Lin Yuan returned his focus to the heavenly gate before him.

The gate was now almost fully materialized, its intricate, mysterious patterns, along with a faint oppressive force, made Lin Yuan’s expression solemn.

Although the heavenly gate’s impression was far less compared to the Door to the Myriad Realms, it was still slightly stronger than Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Not long before, Lin Yuan had personally witnessed Xia Qin Supreme Being reversing the River of Time to resurrect past lives that had died.

Time passed.

Finally, at a certain moment.

The heavenly gate fully materialized.

Rumble.

At the moment the heavenly gate appeared.

A terrifying oppressive force spread in all directions.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

He felt something was off.

With his strength, he could naturally easily withstand this oppressive force.

But that was because Lin Yuan was at the Witch Ancestor’s Fifty Realm, and this force had already surpassed what a normal Witch Ancestor at the Twentieth Realm could handle.

If every time the heavenly gate opened, it was with such oppressive force, what could the Witch Emperor and Witch Ancestor among those native lives use to enter the heavenly gate?

“Let’s push the heavenly gate open first.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, and as soon as the heavenly gate fully materialized, he just needed to push it open to enter.

This was also the ‘step’ that native powerhouses had to perform after the opening of the heavenly gate in the past.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan raised his hands, placed them on the heavenly gate, and then pushed hard.

“Hmm?”

A few breaths later.

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

He actually could not push the heavenly gate open?
